scenario_description:
Objective: Finish preparing service-ready reusable cups for today’s waste-free snack demo without buying disposables or changing the table.
Emerging Need: The cup refresh is underway, then the sanitizer aborts mid-cycle and tags the loaded kit as not service-ready, stopping the same preparation attempt.
Decision Context: The demo still needs cups, the failed load cannot be restarted by volunteers, and stored supply records distinguish whether any no-cost backup can be released before the courier manifest closes.
Consequence: Timely help could keep the started preparation useful for the demo; after the sealed bins leave, the blocked cups cannot serve their intended station.

parameter.title: Waste-free snack demo cup station
parameter.description: Reuse Center community-room snack demo using washable cup set and neutral waste-reduction handout cards.

parameter.content: I’m by the warewash alcove: RDK-A1 cups are loaded, pre-rinse is logged, and the sanitizer display says 28 minutes. I’ll label the snack-station tote after the dry cycle finishes.

parameter.subject: Sanitizer cycle aborted: RDK-A1
parameter.body: The 08:39 sanitizer cycle for reusable dish kit RDK-A1 aborted with heat-hold fault P-17. The load is red-tagged not service-ready, the door remains locked for maintenance review, and volunteer restart is disabled until Facilities Warewash clears the fault.

parameter.subject: Today’s community-room courier manifest timing
parameter.body: For today’s 14:00 community-room setups, the reusable-supply courier manifest seals at 10:15. Items not on the sealed manifest will remain in the Reuse Center staging area until the next route.

parameter.content: The courier just rolled the sealed bins out for the community room. RDK-A1 is still behind the red tag, and the snack-station box left with only the laminated napkin cards.
